verses.1: Sing to the LORD a new song, sing to the LORD all the earth.
verses.2: Sing to the LORD, bless his name, proclaim his salvation from day to day.
verses.3: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvellous works among all the peoples.
verses.4: For the LORD is great and greatly to be praised, he is awesome above all gods.
verses.5: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.6: Splendour and majesty are before him, strength and beauty in his sanctuary.
verses.7: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.8: Ascribe to the LORD the glory of his name, bring an offering and come into his courts.
verses.9: Worship the LORD in the splendour of holiness, tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.10: Say among the nations, "The LORD is king. Indeed, the world is firmly established, it cannot be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity."
verses.11: Let the heavens rejoice and the earth be glad, let the sea and all that fills it resound.
verses.12: Let the fields and everything in them exult, and let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.
verses.13: Before the LORD, for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with his faithfulness.

notes:
Notes
- v. 10: "tебeל bְּmֵישָׁרִֽים" is translated as "the world is firmly established, it cannot be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity," following the context of divine sovereignty and justice.
- v. 10: "תֵּבֵל" is rendered as "the world" and "the peoples" later in the verse for clarity and to avoid repetition, which is natural in English.
